Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Current situation (observed): Day 1, dusk. Wilson is near a lit campfire in a clear grassy patch; the fire was northwest of him, and the last action clicked it to move closer. Latest reported supplies include 2 berries, 2 spare logs, 3 cut grass, and an axe last noted at 85% durability; earlier stack counts were occasionally inconsistent, so verify the current HUD. The immediate plan is to remain in the firelight through the first night and add logs if the flame weakens. Berries may provide food and might be cookable, but eating/cooking has not yet been tested.

Controls/mechanics learned: WASD moves in screen/world directions (D east, S south, S+A southwest, W+A northwest). Clicking a resource generally walks toward and interacts with it, but some clicks only approach or select a neighboring object; Space performs the nearby context action and was needed to finish grass/drop pickups. Holding Space for several seconds repeatedly chopped a tree until it fell. Escape opened the pause menu; clicking Continue once did not visibly resume, while a second Escape did. Crafting tabs are along the upper-left: Tools produced the axe, and Light/flame produced the campfire.

Confirmed progression: Harvested saplings for twigs and grass tufts for cut grass. A pale collectible initially mistaken for flint was identified as Petals and did not satisfy the axe recipe. A later gray ground item made the axe recipe available; the axe consumed a twig/flint and was equipped. Its recipe panel continued showing outdated 0/1 ingredient text after crafting, so the visible equipped axe was the reliable evidence. Chopping one evergreen eventually felled it, yielding logs and pine cones. A campfire was then successfully placed on open ground away from vegetation and ignited. Two berry bushes near the camp were harvested for berries.

Navigation/resource relationships: The original grassy clearing contained saplings, grass, and trees. Traveling east reached a coastline; following it south showed trees but no collected resources. Southwest of that coastal stretch was the Petals location. Returning northwest led back toward the original clearing, where more grass was gathered. Moving farther south revealed berry bushes and the gray flint-like resource. The first chopped evergreen/stump was in this area. The campfire is in a nearby clearing; one berry bush is immediately east/northeast of it and another farther northeast. Returning S+A from the second bush brought the campfire back into view.

Failed/uncertain strategies: A harvested sapling stump was mistaken for a loose item and only warranted examination. Petals are not flint. Several resource clicks required a subsequent Space press, and one grass click stopped beside a tree instead. The eastern/southern coastal exploration yielded no useful pickups. Do not rely on stale crafting-panel ingredient counts. Whether the campfire needs immediate refueling, how long its current flame lasts, and the exact present inventory remain to be checked visually.

Next goals: Stay safe at the campfire overnight; monitor darkness, hunger, and fire strength; fuel it with spare logs if needed; eat/cook berries if hunger becomes urgent. After daylight, resume gathering wood, grass, twigs, flint, and food, keeping camp as the local reference point.
